annotations.title: One question answered from the record

description: Answer one question from oddly's record: the newest observed value of one attribute of one subject, with its figure, both clocks, its source, its receipt and its scope. The figure is what the source published when oddly looked, not an estimate, a forecast or advice. Rate: meter data.answer, US$0.001 per answer, first 100 per month free. An unanswered question (a subject or attribute the record has not observed) is never metered.

attribute.description: The attribute to answer, exactly as record_subject_history lists it.

subject_key.description: The subject key exactly as the record prints it on /record/subject?key=..., e.g. 'benchmark-cell:commerce/baby/clothing|SG|*|local|*|*'.
